velocity_section.track_geometry_role: WGS84 straight segments between hourly mean source positions; not sailed distance, a current axis, flow orientation or physical current edges. Bearings near stationary positions are unstable.
velocity_section.label: Aleutian / Subarctic region: July1993 observed vector section
velocity_section.velocity_frame: earth coordinates: eastward u and northward v
velocity_section.source_product: hourly reduced product at10m intervals; not native5minute/4m ensembles
velocity_section.layer_weighting: Midpoint cell thickness, clipped at100and300m; jointly valid u/v; coverage<160m produces null means. No vertical interpolation.
source_processing_cautions: GPS selective availability and heading corrections described in provider metadata; velocities already processed by the University of Hawaii.
Provider metadata record CTD wire interference editing and missing bins. The hourly product has no per-cell native editing history; nulls and joint support are retained.
100–300m follows the published regional comparison, not an assumed depth-independent current width.
Track includes small northward steps and a two-hour gap. Preserve acquisition order; do not silently form a single monotone width crossing.
Northern and southern branch windows follow Chen and Firing(2006), section3 paragraph7. Windows are association context, not detected edges.

scope_notes: Nominal CF timestamps are checked against unique BO events in the original summary; BO is cast bottom, not passage through100–300m.
Temporal/spatial candidate correspondence does not establish simultaneity, flow association or a unique cast-to-hour pairing.
All source QC codes and finite raw values are retained. Only jointly acceptable WOCECTD2 samples count as supported water-property cells.
The current cruise page reports a2001temperature-correction issue; later conversion dates do not by themselves establish its resolution. Values are not silently corrected.
The upper-ocean display retains0–350m measured cells. Pressure remains available beside converted depth; no vertical or horizontal interpolation is applied.

interpretation: Source paper places branches near 45 N and 42 N and an eddy near 41.5 N. Its same-cruise interpretation does not validate these OSW component boundaries.
Acquisition order includes CTD occupations and northward steps. These means are not exclusively underway cross-track velocities.
Threshold-choice and velocity-perturbation scenarios are separate finite sensitivities, not annual ranges or total measurement uncertainty.
CTD companion retains quality codes, nominal-bottom pairing ambiguity and unresolved historical temperature-correction notice. No new water-mass classification is made.
